title: Data for filtered condensed representing pairs
statement: Fix a prime l, a positive-characteristic field k with characteristic different from l, finite-type separated k-schemes X and Y, a k-morphism f:X to Y and a compactification c of f [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the finite and closure condensed constructible categories [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit], define ScalarComparisons to consist of the support/scalar comparison isomorphisms; IsCanonical requires their underlying maps, conjugated by the inclusion comparisons, to equal the original projection mates [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. A Pair at a finite coefficient field E consists of objects M,L, a counit t:P_E(M) to L, and finite-overfield Hom bijections beta. IsCompatible requires beta(a)=P(a) followed by the scalar-extended t through the inverse scalar comparison. Define omegaM, omegaL, omegaCounit by scalar extension and the inverse closure comparison. OmegaBijections is the family of representing Hom equivalences, IsInduced its finite-stage value formula, and IsNatural its contravariant naturality. A DataMap consists of maps of M and L at a common finite overfield respecting beta, and omegaA,omegaB are their extensions through tensor transitivity. IsDescent is the conjunction of the induced formula, naturality, counit formula and identity value, uniqueness, model independence, and chosen-adjoint transpose invertibility, counit uniqueness and pair-map naturality. All constructions are the verbatim original data definitions of lem-pur-filtered-condensed-representing-pair, moved unchanged to a data module to permit proof-step imports.
